newsitem.title: USA: Report says Capsure, CNA in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Report says Capsure, CNA in merger talks.

text.p: CNA Insurance is in talks to merge with Capsure Holdings Inc, according to a report in Insurance Finance & Investment, a biweekly publication.
Last week, Capsure, a surety and fidelity bond holding company, said it was in preliminary discussions on a possible stock merger with another party. The party was not identified.
At that time, Capsure also said a proposed transaction had not been presented to its board of directors for approval and there was no assurance a definitive agreement would be reached.
CNA Insurance is a subsidiary of CNA Financial Corp in Chicago. The company's stock was down 3/8 Thursday afternoon at 11-7/8.
